title: feat(spec): a strict response contract for GET /auth/me/permissions, and hasAnyQueue on IOwnershipQueueService
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRMukpcDXWQXQ4GaVYCkErv)_

Fixes #28508

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`GET /auth/me/permissions` 第一次有了 spec 里的严格响应契约 `MePermissionsResponseSchema`（`@objectstack/spec/api`），覆盖匿名、降级（无 SecurityPlugin）、完整、故障关闭四种响应体，声明了 `hasAnyQueue: boolean`，未声明的同级键直接拒绝。`IOwnershipQueueService` 契约加上可选方法 `hasAnyQueue?(organizationId)`，路由改为通过契约读取，删掉本地的 `AnyQueueReader` 可选类型。控制台 `@object-ui/permissions` 的 `MePermissionsResponse` 改为从 spec 派生，不再手写。
- **为什么改**：#28508 的 spec 一半（服务端一半已由 #28654 合入）。控制台每个会话读一次这个响应来驱动整个权限层，之前只有 ui 里手写的接口，服务端多发或少发一个键都没人拦。手写接口已经漂移：它读一个服务端从不发送的 `roles` 键（服务端的键是 `positions`），所以 `MePermissionsProvider` 下的 `usePermissions().roles` 一直是空数组。
- **风险与回滚**：线上响应字节不变。`hasAnyQueue?` 是可选方法（与 `declaredQueueNamed?` 一样），仓库外的旧实现照样满足契约，路由对缺这个方法的实现答 `false`。控制台行为只有一处变化：`usePermissions().roles` 从恒为空变为服务端的 `positions`（仓库内没有生产代码读它）。`@object-ui/permissions` 导出的 `MePermissionsResponse` 变为 spec 的联合类型，按它写的测试夹具随之迁移（`roles` → `positions`，加 `hasAnyQueue`）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts`（三个 schema）、`packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`（新方法）、`packages/spec/src/api/me-permissions-response.test.ts`（契约测试 12 例）、`ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx`（派生类型与 `roles`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/me-permissions-response.test.ts`，预期 12 passed；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server exec vitest run src/current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts`，预期 9 passed（每个真实响应体都过严格 schema）。
- **需要你做的**：无。contract review owed：入队前由席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 给出 `## Contract review` PASS（567e3dc8 上的首轮为 FAIL，本版逐条修复，待增量复审）。

## What changes

- **`MePermissionsResponseSchema`** (`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts`), a `z.discriminatedUnion('authenticated', …)` of two strict branches:
  - `MePermissionsAnonymousResponseSchema`: `{ authenticated: false }` and nothing else, so nothing about a user can ride on the anonymous body.
  - `MePermissionsAuthenticatedResponseSchema`: `userId`, `tenantId` (nullable), `positions`, `permissionSets`, `objects` (record of `EffectiveObjectPermissionSchema`), `fields` (record of a strict `{ readable, editable }`), `systemPermissions` and `tabPermissions` (both optional: absent only on the degraded body, where absent means unknown, and present-and-empty means none), and **`hasAnyQueue: boolean`** (required on every authenticated body).
  - Types `MePermissionsResponse`, `MePermissionsAnonymousResponse`, `MePermissionsAuthenticatedResponse` (`z.input`). The three schemas are isomorphic, so they take ADR-0122 `Iso_` pins in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (count 808 → 811) rather than `Parsed` aliases.
- **`IOwnershipQueueService.hasAnyQueue?(organizationId: string | null): Promise<boolean>`** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`): `true` exactly when some name would resolve through `resolveQueue`. **Optional**, like `declaredQueueNamed?`, so an implementation written before it still satisfies the contract; the route answers `false` without it. Its docblock names `/auth/me/permissions` as the one carrier and says it discloses no name and no count. plugin-sharing's `OwnershipQueueService` already implements it (#28654); only its docblock changes.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`** (`current-user-endpoints.ts`): the route reads the method as `Pick<IOwnershipQueueService, 'hasAnyQueue'>` through the kernel locator, keeping the runtime `typeof` guard so an older implementation still answers `false`. `mePermissionsBody` (the full and closed bodies) returns `MePermissionsAuthenticatedResponse`, so tsc refuses a key the schema does not declare. The degraded literal and the anonymous `{ authenticated: false }` stay bare `c.json({...})` literals: an inline `satisfies` hid both from the `check:route-envelope` census (found 7, pinned 9), so they are bound by the strict parse in the route and door tests instead. The wire is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/permissions`** (`ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx`): `MePermissionsResponse` is re-exported from `@objectstack/spec/api` (with `MePermissionsAuthenticatedResponse` beside it) in place of the hand-written interface `check:spec-symbols` flagged. The provider reads grants only from the authenticated branch. The interface's `roles` key was drift (the server sends `positions`), so the context's `roles` now carries `positions`. `ui/apps/console/src/components/studioEntry.ts` narrows on `authenticated` before reading `systemPermissions`. Test fixtures across 13 UI packages typed as the response move `roles: [...]` → `positions: [...]` and add `hasAnyQueue: false`; builders that answer `authenticated: true` are typed as the authenticated branch; three `{ readable: false }` field entries gain `editable: false` (the strict entry declares both); the anonymous fixtures are `{ authenticated: false }`.
- **Skill index.** An `objectstack-api` row in `TRANSITIVE_ALLOWLIST` (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/skill-map-guards.ts`) lists the 13 transitive pointers the index already published, so the new `auth.zod.ts` → `security/permission.zod.ts` edge no longer drags 22 more into `skills/objectstack-api/references/_index.md` (the file is now identical to main's).
- **Variant-doc ledger.** The `authenticated:false|true` union is declared `not-authorable` in `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`.
- **Generated artifacts** regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, authorable-surface and json-schema manifests, the reference docs (`content/docs/references/api/auth.mdx`, `index.mdx` 1582 → 1585) and the strictness ledger counts (472 → 475).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28508-me-permissions-response-contract.md`: **`minor` for `@objectstack/spec`** (Metadata-protocol `added`: the authorable-surface baseline moves, per the precedent of #28440 / #28447 / #28595), `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@object-ui/permissions`, with the `roles` → `positions` mapping for a fixture author.

## Tests

- **Contract** (`packages/spec/src/api/me-permissions-response.test.ts`, new, 12 cases): the anonymous, full, closed and degraded bodies parse; `hasAnyQueue` is declared, must be a boolean (`'yes'`, `2` refused at path `hasAnyQueue`) and is required; an unknown sibling on the authenticated body is refused with `unrecognized_keys` naming the key, not dropped; an unknown sibling on the anonymous body is refused too (`hasAnyQueue`, `userId`); a field entry is closed; absent and empty `systemPermissions` both parse and stay distinct; a tab visibility outside the four is refused at `tabPermissions.sales`; a non-boolean discriminator matches no branch.
- **Route** (`plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts`): every body the handler answers in the 9 cases (full, degraded, closed, anonymous, service absent / without the method / throwing) is now also parsed through `MePermissionsResponseSchema` and must have no issues.
- **HTTP door** (`verify/src/me-permissions-has-any-queue.test.ts`, 5 cases): the raw body each real boot answers is parsed through `MePermissionsResponseSchema` and must have no issues, before `hasAnyQueue` is read.

<details><summary>Red first, green after, ablations</summary>

- **Red on main.** The contract test against `origin/main`'s `auth.zod.ts`: every case red (the three schemas do not exist).
- **Green.** Contract 12/12, route 9/9, door 5/5.
- **Ablation A, strictness dropped** (`.strict()` → `.passthrough()` on the authenticated branch): the contract case "an unknown sibling is refused on the authenticated body" goes red, 1 failed / 11 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- **Ablation C, the route sends an undeclared key** (`ablation-replace.mjs` adds `ablation28508ExtraKey` to `mePermissionsBody`; `ablation-dist-preflight` finds the marker in plugin-hono-server `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`): route test 7 failed / 2 passed (the degraded and anonymous cases do not go through `mePermissionsBody`, by design), door test 5 failed (5). Restored: blob == HEAD, rebuilt, marker absent. This is the reading that the route and door tests are bound to the strict schema.
- **Ablation B, not measured.** Renaming `hasAnyQueue` in the spec schema was refused by the spec build itself (the `gen:schema` baseline gate refuses a key removal), so dist stayed at HEAD and no test reading dist could see it. Ablation A covers the contract side and C the consumer side.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance 1 (declared strictly, unknown sibling refused)**: met by the strict authenticated and anonymous branches and pinned by the contract test. `EffectiveObjectPermissionSchema` (the value type of `objects`) is the existing `security/permission.zod` schema and keeps its own tolerance; this PR makes the top level and the `fields` entries strict and does not re-shape the shared permission schema.
- **Contract method optional** (contract review on `567e3dc8`, must-fix 2): `hasAnyQueue?` like `declaredQueueNamed?`; a required member would have been an undeclared break for an out-of-tree implementer.
- **No client method.** A typed `auth.mePermissions()` in `@objectstack/client` was tried and dropped: `client-url-conformance` requires every SDK URL to match an exact route-ledger entry, and `/auth/me/permissions` sits in no ledger (it matched only the `* /auth/**` wildcard). The seat files the typed client method as its own card.
- **Metadata-protocol `added`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`** (contract review must-fix 1): the PR moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (11 new schema keys), and `check-changeset` reads a moved baseline under `none` as `none-baseline-moved`. The kind follows the baseline, as in #28440 / #28447 / #28595, so `@objectstack/spec` ships `minor`.
- **Console reads the typed contract.** `@object-ui/permissions` now derives its response type from the spec, so a key the server adds or drops shows up in the console's typecheck. The toolbar consumer of `hasAnyQueue` (#28428) is not wired here.

## Verification

All readings on head `0eb64410` (the final commit), on main `3944d2e1`. The first round (head `567e3dc8`, whole-workspace build 118/118) is in the PR history; this round changes the spec contract, the changeset and `ui/`, so everything below was re-measured after rebuilding the spec, plugin-sharing, plugin-hono-server and `@object-ui/permissions`.

- **Contract review fixes.** Must-fix 1: changeset and body declare `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` `minor`; `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` with `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` set to a pull-request event carrying this body: exit 0. Red first: the same command with `567e3dc8`'s changeset and the old `none` body exits 1 with CI's refusal ("metadata-protocol declares `none` while an authorable-surface or authorable-defaults baseline moved · Moved: packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json"). Must-fix 2: `hasAnyQueue?` optional. Should-fix (a): `skills/objectstack-api/references/_index.md` is identical to main's (`git diff origin/main` empty). Should-fix (b): the doc cross-reference is in `auth.zod.ts`.
- **UI.** `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`: exit 0 ("0 untriaged collisions"). Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) of `@object-ui/permissions`, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-detail, plugin-gantt, plugin-form, plugin-view, plugin-list, plugin-grid, fields, plugin-report and app-shell, plus `apps/console` `tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors each. Tests: `@object-ui/permissions` 15 files, 166/166; every UI test file that names the response type, the provider or the route (143 files across those packages): Test Files 143 passed (143), Tests 1761 passed (1761). eslint on the provider, the package entry and `studioEntry.ts`: exit 0.
- **Package suites.** `@objectstack/spec`: 23185 passed, 1 todo. `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`: 466/466. `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`: 1302/1302. Door test: 5/5. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Generated artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0 after `--fix` regenerated `gen:skill-refs` for the allowlist row.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 115 commands, **all 115 exit 0 on `0eb64410`**; `--ran`: "115 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 115 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- **Not local.** `test:repo`, the full Test Core shards and the full UI suite are CI's. No full dogfood battery is owed: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
